jobs.title: Senior Director Enterprise Architecture & Ontology
jobs.description:
A career as a Senior Director, Enterprise Architecture & Ontology within the Enterprise Architecture team at National Bank means acting as the Senior Director responsible for Enterprise Architecture and Integrated Enterprise Knowledge. It means contributing to the definition and evolution of a strategic practice that provides a better understanding of the relationships between business capabilities, processes, data, applications, interfaces, technologies, and controls. This role allows you to make a positive impact on our organization through your expertise in enterprise architecture, semantic modelling, and organizational transformation supported by artificial intelligence and automation.

Your job

Shape
the evolution of the enterprise architecture practice by defining
directions, methods, standards, and priorities that support
decision-making and organizational transformation.

Define
and evolve an enterprise ontology that connects business capabilities,
processes, data, applications, interfaces, technology components, and
controls through clear semantics and governed relationships.

Establish
modelling principles, governance mechanisms, and accountabilities that
enable different teams to contribute to a shared, reliable, and reusable
understanding of the enterprise.

Leverage
artificial intelligence and automation to discover and reconcile
relationships across LeanIX, the CMDB, and other authoritative sources
without creating a new monolithic repository, while ensuring information
quality, governance, and traceability.

Transform
the enterprise ontology into products, views, integrations, and use cases
that support strategic planning, impact analysis, technology decisions,
and transformation initiatives.

Represent
the practice in architecture and delivery forums, engage stakeholders, and
measure adoption, coverage, and value delivered to adjust priorities based
on the organization’s needs.

Your team

The Enterprise Architecture practice brings together
specialists who work collaboratively to develop an integrated understanding of
the organization and support its transformation. You work closely with
architecture, business, data, technology, and platform teams.

Within the Enterprise Architecture sector, you report
to the Bank’s Chief Architect. You contribute to transforming knowledge that is
currently distributed across multiple teams, repositories, and tools into a
coherent, accessible, and actionable view that supports decision-making.

We aim to provide you with maximum flexibility to
enhance your quality of life. This includes a hybrid work environment as well
as a flexible and adaptable schedule.

The Bank values continuous development and internal
mobility. Our personalized training programs, based on learning through
experience, help you master your role and develop new areas of expertise.
Resources such as the Data Academy, language training, the Harvard Learning
Center, as well as coaching and mentoring support, are available to you at all
times.

Prerequisites

University
degree in engineering, computer science, or a related field and at least
ten years of relevant experience in enterprise or solution architecture.

In-depth
expertise in enterprise ontology, semantic modelling, or knowledge graphs,
as well as modelling relationships between business and technology assets.

Strong
command of enterprise architecture repositories and authoritative sources,
including LeanIX and CMDBs.

Expertise
in information governance, data quality, traceability, and the
reconciliation of data from multiple sources.

Hands-on
experience with artificial intelligence and automation applied to
relationship discovery, knowledge quality improvement, and the delivery of
enterprise capabilities.

Strong
understanding of integration architectures, application programming
interfaces (APIs), event-driven architectures, cloud computing, and
digital ecosystems.

Languages: French, English
Reason to require this language: you will need to discuss frequently with our service providers or partners who speak a language other than French.
Required skills: Artificial Intelligence, Automation, Critical Thinking, Cross-functional Collaboration, Enterprise Architecture, Enterprise Integration, Influencing Skills, Information Governance, Innovation Management, Knowledge Graph, Micro Focus UCMDB, Model Making, Ontologies, Semantics, Strategic Vision, Strategy Execution

Your benefits

In addition to competitive compensation, upon hiring you’ll be eligible for a wide range of flexible benefits to help promote your wellbeing and that of your family such as:

* Health and wellness program, including many options
* Flexible group insurance
* Generous pension plan
* Employee Share Ownership Plan
* Employee and family assistance program
* Preferential banking services
* Involvement in community initiatives
* Telemedicine service
* Virtual sleep clinic

We have an offer that keeps up with trends as well as your needs and those of your family.

Our dynamic work environments and cutting-edge collaboration tools foster a positive employee experience. We value employees’ ideas. Whether through our surveys or programs, regular feedback and ongoing communication are encouraged.

Making a bold move in a people-first environment

We’re a bank on a human scale that stands out for its courage, entrepreneurial culture, and passion for people. Our mission is to have a positive impact on people’s lives. Our core values of partnership, agility, and empowerment inspire us, and inclusion is central to our commitments. We aim, wherever possible, to provide a barrier-free and accessible environment to all employees.

We strive to provide accessibility measures throughout the recruitment process within the limits of our available resources. If you require accommodations, feel free to let us know during our initial conversations. We welcome all candidates! What can you bring to our team?

Join us!

jobs.title: Technology Director - Global Sourcing Technology, Supply Chain
jobs.description:
Requirements

Description & Requirements

Technology Director | Global Sourcing Technology

Who we are

lululemon is an innovative performance apparel company for yoga, running, training, and other athletic pursuits. Setting the bar in technical fabrics and functional design, we create transformational products and experiences that support people in moving, growing, connecting, and being well. We owe our success to our innovative product, emphasis on stores, commitment to our people, and the incredible connections we make in every community we're in. As a company, we focus on creating positive change to build a healthier, thriving future. In particular, that includes creating an equitable, inclusive and growth-focused environment for our people.

About This Team

Global Supply Chain Technology delivers the platforms and capabilities that power lululemon’s supply chain—from raw material innovation and development, costing, sourcing, quality, sustainability and traceability, trade, logistics, and distribution technology. Our team works in close partnership with core business units to ensure that our supply chain remains agile, efficient, and responsive to ever-evolving market demands. By continuously innovating and refining our technological solutions, we enable best-in-class supply chain operations to service our Guests and our stores. This collaborative approach ensures we provide exceptional experiences and support lululemon’s growth in every community we serve.

The role

We are seeking a Technology Director to define and execute the multi year strategy for modernizing and transforming lululemon’s global sourcing technology ecosystem. This leader will shape the strategic roadmap, elevate costing and sourcing platform capabilities, advance AI driven decisioning, and ensure operational excellence across the systems that connect lululemon to its global vendor base.

You will own all aspects of technology for Global Sourcing—architecture, engineering, security, QA automation, operations, and delivery—and oversee a globally distributed team across North America and India. You will be accountable for the platforms that support approximately 300 raw material (RM) and finished goods (FG) vendors globally, and will partner with Enterprise Architecture and Engineering on the technology evolution required to support enterprise initiatives. This role requires a seasoned leader with a proven record of developing a strong leadership bench, managing complex solutions, and thriving in complex, fast paced, and highly collaborative environments.

This Role Oversees Technology Solutions Supporting

Product costing and should-cost modelling (materials, labor, overhead, landed cost)
Sourcing execution (quoting and RFQ, vendor award, capacity allocation and booking)
Purchase order management and order lifecycle for raw material and finished goods
Supplier collaboration portals and vendor-facing self-service
Partner connectivity (vendors, mills, agents, service providers)
Integration frameworks (EDI, APIs, event-driven architecture)
Master data and data quality for cost
Sourcing analytics, margin visibility, exception management, and operational dashboards

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Roadmap

Define and deliver a multi year global sourcing technology strategy that enhances scalability, reliability, and speed to market.
Translate business needs into an actionable engineering roadmap incorporating modernization, cloud migration, supplier collaboration, and responsible AI adoption.
Partner with business Directors, Sr. Directors, and VPs across Global Sourcing and Costing to define, deliver, and support the strategic roadmap.
Enroll cross functional technology partners in the strategic vision for Global Sourcing, and lead the creation and expansion of new capabilities that align with our strategic goals.

Platform & Architecture Modernization

Modernize existing costing and sourcing platforms and integrate next generation capabilities (costing engines, sourcing execution suites, or equivalent).
Drive transformation toward API-first, event-driven, and scalable integration architectures across the global vendor base.
Lead design and implementation of secure, resilient, and responsible data management and governance frameworks for material, vendor, and cost master data.
Partner with Enterprise Architecture and Engineering on technology evolution that supports enterprise initiatives.

Engineering Leadership

Lead globally distributed engineering, QA automation, delivery, and support teams; develop managers and future-ready technical leaders.
Serve as the escalation point for Technology Managers to support delivery, making thoughtful decisions on the fly and constantly clearing roadblocks.
Raise engineering standards around quality, observability, security, and system reliability.
Build high performing, diverse teams with a culture of inclusion, transparency, and continuous improvement, and support career progression and stretch opportunities across the Global Sourcing technology area.

Operational Excellence

Oversee delivery, operations, and vendor/partner management across sourcing and costing systems, and own the relationship with key vendor partners.
Manage budgets for strategic initiatives and baseline opex for Global Sourcing technology, ensuring clear ROI and optimization of total cost of ownership.
Drive root cause analysis, systems reliability, service maturity, and measurable operational improvements.

Innovation & AI Enablement

Introduce AI-driven decision support for should-cost modelling, quote analysis, capacity allocation, vendor performance, and exception management.
Champion ethical, transparent, and responsible use of AI in sourcing and vendor-facing operations.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, related field, or commensurate relative experience.
15+ years of experience in technology, including 4+ years in a senior leadership position such as a Technology Manager or Technology Director.
Experience leading large scale initiatives and modernization efforts for supply chain platforms, with highly valued experience in costing and sourcing areas.
Proven success delivering transformations in areas such as product costing, sourcing execution, purchase order management, supplier collaboration, or vendor connectivity.
Strong background in integration architectures (API platforms, EDI, message streaming, event-driven design).
Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
Proficiency in programming languages such as Python or Java and familiarity with data engineering patterns.
Demonstrated ability to manage large budgets and deliver high-impact technology programs.
Exceptional communication, storytelling, and executive influencing skills.
Continuous learning mindset that stays on the leading edge of sourcing and supply chain technology solutions that can bring value to the organization.
Experience with AI/ML use cases in supply chain, sourcing, or costing.
Understanding of apparel or consumer goods product development, raw materials, and global vendor management processes.
Experience working with distributed teams across multiple time zones and a global vendor base.

Success Metrics

Improved cost accuracy, margin visibility, and speed of costing cycles.
Reduced sourcing and purchase order cycle times, with fewer manual touches per order.
Improved reliability, uptime, and SLA performance of sourcing and costing systems.
Strong engagement scores and leadership development of global teams.

Must Haves

Acknowledges the presence of choice in every moment and takes personal responsibility for their life.
Possesses an entrepreneurial spirit and continuously innovates to achieve great results.
Communicates with honesty and kindness and creates the space for others to do the same.
Leads with courage, knowing the possibility of greatness is bigger than the fear of failure.
Fosters connection by putting people first and building trusting relationships.
Integrates fun and joy as a way of being and working, aka doesn’t take themselves too seriously.

additional notes

Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time for this role.

Compensation And Benefits Package

lululemon’s compensation offerings are grounded in a pay-for-performance philosophy that recognizes exceptional individual and team performance. The typical hiring range for this position is from  $190,400 - $249,900  annually; the base pay offered is based on market location and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and internal equity. As part of our total rewards offering, permanent employees in this position may be eligible for our competitive annual bonus program and equity offerings, subject to program eligibility requirements.  

At Lululemon, Investing In Our People Is a Top Priority. We Believe That When Life Works, Work Works. We Strive To Be The Place Where Inclusive Leaders Come To Develop And Enable All To Be Well. Recognizing Our Teams For Their Performance And Dedication, Other Components Of Our Total Rewards Offerings Include Support Of Career Development, Wellbeing, And Personal Growth

Extended health and dental benefits, and mental health plans
Paid time off
Savings and retirement plan matching
Generous employee discount
Fitness & yoga classes
Parenthood top-up
Extensive catalog of development course offerings
People networks, mentorship programs, and leadership series (to name a few)

Note: The incentive programs, benefits, and perks have certain eligibility requirements. The Company reserves the right to alter these incentive programs, benefits, and perks in whole or in part at any time without advance notice.

workplace arrangement

Hybrid

In-person collaboration and connection is important to our culture. Work is performed onsite, minimum 4 days per week.

Authorization to work in Canada is required for this role.

jobs.description:

Drives the evolution, quality and market success of our Manufacturing offerings and the delivery of its priority solutions with a focus on Smart Factory including our Manufacturing OS solution. Leads regional capability build and drives business growth in close partnership with Client Groups, Industry leadership and Microsoft.

This role is location-flexible within Canada, provided the individual is within commuting distance of an Avanade office.

Drive pipeline growth, positioning and deal closure for Smart Factory offerings
Partner with Client Groups and Industry leaders to shape growth strategies, and support opportunities directly through client presentations, demonstrations and executive-level storytelling
Strengthen ecosystem collaboration with Microsoft and Accenture Supply Chain & Engineering.

jobs.title: Banking Partnerships & Quality Director
jobs.description:
ADP is hiring a Banking Partnerships & Quality Director

The Director, Bank Partnerships, Analytics and Quality is an individual and senior leadership role within Payments Operations responsible for strengthening and managing strategic relationships with Banking Partners while delivering data-driven insights that support business growth, operational excellence and quality framework required to operate a high-performing payments organization and client satisfaction.

This role serves as the primary liaison between Payment Operations and its banking partners, ensuring relationships are proactively managed, service expectations are clearly defined, performance is measured, issues are escalated appropriately, and opportunities for improvement are identified and delivered. The Director leverages data analytics and business intelligence to identify trends, opportunities, risks, and performance improvements across payment operations and partner performance.

The Director will work to create consistent standards, measurements, reporting and governance across payment processes. The role will translate operational data into actionable insights and establish quality standards that enable the organization to improve service, reduce risk, increase efficiency and support business growth.

The successful candidate will combine relationship management expertise, financial services knowledge, and analytical leadership to influence business decisions and strengthen strategic partnerships.

Ready to #MakeYourMark? Apply now!

What You’ll Do

Strategic Bank Partner Management

Own the operational relationship with key banking and financial institution partners supporting the company’s payment ecosystem.

Develop and maintain executive-level relationships with banking partners.
Serve as the primary point of contact for partner banks on operational performance, and issue management.
Lead formal quarterly business reviews and governance meetings with banking partners.
Monitor partner performance against established service level agreements (SLAs) and key performance indicators (KPIs).
Negotiate service enhancements & operational improvements
Escalate and resolve operational, compliance, or service-related issues impacting business performance.

Data Analytics & Quality

Analyze transactional, operational, and partner performance data to identify trends and opportunities.
Develop dashboards and executive reporting for senior leadership.
Translate complex data into actionable insights and recommendations.
Identify operational bottlenecks and recommend process improvements.
Measure performance of banking partners through scorecards and performance metrics.
Support forecasting, capacity planning, and strategic decision-making using data-driven analysis.
Partner with Finance, Product, Technology and Business teams to ensure operational analytics support business growth and strategic decision-making.
Maintain and enforce Unit of Work measures for payment operations.
Drive initiatives focused on efficiency, cost reduction, automation, and service improvement.
Lead root cause analyses related to operational issues and partner performance.

Risk & Compliance Management

Ensure partner activities align with regulatory requirements and internal policies.
Monitor operational, financial, and reputational risks related to banking partnerships.
Support audits, regulatory reviews, and compliance assessments involving banking partners.
Partner with Risk and Compliance teams to mitigate emerging risks.

Leadership

Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Lead cross-functional initiatives involving Operations, Product, Risk, Compliance, Technology, and Finance teams.
Present recommendations and business insights to executive leadership.

TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE:
Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Data Analytics, Commerce, or related field.
10+ years of progressive experience within financial services, payments, banking, fintech or a related operational environment.
5+ years managing strategic client or bank partner relationships.
Experience working with payment systems, payroll, ACH/EFT, wire payments, or treasury operations.
Demonstrated experience leveraging data analytics to influence business decisions.
Experience presenting to executive leadership and external stakeholders.
Experience developing operational analytics, dashboards and executive reporting.
Experience establishing operational KPIs, SLAs, quality standards and performance-management frameworks.
Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional initiatives involving Operations, Product, Technology, Risk and Compliance.
Experience managing complex operational escalations and external partner relationships.

Technical Skills

Strong understanding of payment processing, banking operations and the Canadian payments ecosystem.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Advanced proficiency with Excel, Power BI, Tableau, SQL, or similar analytical tools.
Strong understanding of operational risk, controls and quality management.
Experience developing KPIs, dashboards, and executive reporting.
Understanding of payment processing, risk management, and banking operations.
Strong negotiation, influencing and stakeholder-management capabilities.
Ability to establish structure and standards in a developing or evolving organization.
Knowledge of Canadian payments ecosystem considered an asset.

Leadership Competencies

Strategic thinking – connects operational performance to business strategy and growth.
External leadership – builds trusted relationships with banking and strategic partners.
Data-driven leadership – uses analytics to identify trends, risks and opportunities.
Operational excellence – establishes measurable standards and drives continuous improvement.
Influence – brings together stakeholders across Operations, Product, Technology, Risk and Compliance.
Executive presence – communicates clearly with senior leaders and external executives.
Accountability – establishes ownership, transparency and follow-through.
Change leadership – creates structure and standards in a changing payment.

Success Metrics

The Director Will Be Measured On

Banking partner satisfaction and relationship health.
Achievement of partner service level agreements.
Operational performance improvement.
Reduction in payment exceptions and operational risks.
Delivery of actionable business insights.
Executive stakeholder satisfaction.
Cost optimization initiatives.
Successful implementation of strategic partner initiatives starting with Unit of Work.

Bonus Points For These

MBA or advanced degree considered an asset.
Relevant professional certifications in payments, banking, project management, risk, analytics or quality management are considered an asset.

jobs.title: National Vice President, Electrical
jobs.description:
The National Vice President of Electrical owns the commercial success, strategic growth, and financial performance of the Electrical division across Ontario and potential expansion markets. This leader is accountable for P&L performance, revenue growth, market positioning, and enterprise integration.

Why This Role Matters to Modern Niagara

The National Vice President of Electrical is key to Modern Niagara’s ability to grow its Electrical business profitably, strengthen client relationships, and expand into new markets. By aligning Electrical with Mechanical and Construction teams, this leader helps deliver integrated solutions that meet clients’ needs and create opportunities across the business. This role also builds the leadership and operational capacity needed to support long-term growth while maintaining a safety-first culture.

Key Impact / Purpose

Drive profitable growth of the Electrical division through strategic market expansion, strong client relationships, and disciplined financial leadership.
Strengthen Modern Niagara’s integrated offering by aligning Electrical, Mechanical, and Construction teams to pursue and deliver client solutions.
Build the leadership, talent, and operational capacity needed to sustain long-term growth while championing a safety-first culture.

D
uties and Responsibilities:

Strategic Growth & Market Expansion

Develop and execute a 3–5 year Electrical growth strategy aligned with corporate objectives.
Identify priority verticals.
Lead geographic expansion nationally.
Evaluate partnerships, joint ventures, and acquisition opportunities.

Business Development & Client Leadership

Own revenue growth targets and pipeline development.
Develop C-suite and senior client relationships with developers, GCs, municipalities, and institutional clients.
Lead major pursuits and positioning strategies for complex projects.
Collaborate inter-departmentally to drive integrated design-build opportunities.
Increase cross-selling across service lines.

P&L and Financial Leadership

Full P&L ownership for the Electrical division.
Drive margin performance and cost discipline.
Oversee forecasting, backlog management, and pricing strategy.
Improve bid-to-win ratios and ensure disciplined project selection.
Lead financial reviews with executive leadership.

Organizational Leadership

Provide direction and performance oversight to the Senior Leaders
Scale the Electrical division (talent acquisition, succession planning, leadership bench).
Align operational capacity with growth strategy.
Champion a high-performance, safety-first culture.

Enterprise Alignment

Participate in corporate strategic planning.
Support capital planning and resource allocation decisions.
Ensure integrated execution with Mechanical and Construction teams.

Must haves:

12+ years in electrical contracting, engineering, or construction.
5–10 years in senior leadership with P&L accountability.
Proven track record growing revenue in the construction market.
Strong relationships within ICI
Financial fluency (WIP reporting, margin analysis, forecasting).
Eng. or trade background.

Defined Contribution Pension Plan with a generous employer contribution

An annual health spending account to support your overall wellness 
24/7 confidential support through our Employee and Family Assistance Program with access to comprehensive resources and professional services

jobs.title: Director, Terminal Experience & Groundside Services
jobs.description:
Toronto Pearson is transforming. Now’s the time for your career to fly.

The Greater Toronto Airports Authority (GTAA) is a unique and dynamic place to work, with a bold plan to make Toronto Pearson, Canada’s leading global hub airport, a global leader in airport performance, customer care and sustainability. Together with our partners, approximately 2,100 GTAA employees are working to create a next-generation airport by innovating in all we do and striving for the most uplifting, safe and efficient experience for our passengers – all while championing the prosperity of our people, the community we call home, and our aviation partners. Join us on our journey together, as we put the joy back into travel and make Toronto Pearson the chosen place to fly and work.

What's in it for you?

An opportunity to grow, develop, and thrive within a dynamic, and fast-growing company alongside thoughtful and passionate individuals dedicated to their work and community.
Eligibility to participate in our Group Health Benefits Program.
A flexible hybrid work environment, continuous internal and external learning opportunities, and a meaningful reward and recognition program.

What can you expect from this position?

Reporting to the Executive Director, Operations and Customer Services Delivery, the Director, Terminal Experience and Groundside Services is accountable for delivering seamless, resilient, and customer-focused terminal and groundside operations. Leading a team of 140+ professionals, this role drives operational excellence, safety, and service quality while championing innovation and readiness for transformative initiatives such as LIFT.

The Director will play a pivotal role in shaping the future operating model of Toronto Pearson, one that integrates real-time decision-making, digital tools, and cross-functional service delivery to deliver exceptional passenger experiences and operational resilience.

As a Director, Terminal Experience and Groundside Services, you will:

Shape Resilient and Adaptable Operations by setting the vision and leading the creation of annual operating plans aligned with GTAA’s strategic priorities.
Ensure world-class standards for passenger flow, safety, and operational reliability across terminals and groundside environments while driving continuous improvement and operational resilience.
Champion Operational Excellence in Customer Experience and Innovation by leading the execution of GTAA’s Customer Experience Strategy, embedding best-in-class service standards into day-to-day operations, and implementing innovative programs that enhance passenger satisfaction and transform terminal environments.
Drive operational improvements through test-and-learn initiatives, seamless digital integration, and continuous process optimization to ensure a consistent, high-quality experience across all customer touchpoints.
Enable Growth and Operational Readiness by anticipating future capacity challenges, leading optimization strategies to address bottlenecks and improve curbside traffic flow, and ensuring readiness for major infrastructure programs such as LIFT.

Requirements

Description & Requirements

Technology Director | Global Sourcing Technology

Who we are

lululemon is an innovative performance apparel company for yoga, running, training, and other athletic pursuits. Setting the bar in technical fabrics and functional design, we create transformational products and experiences that support people in moving, growing, connecting, and being well. We owe our success to our innovative product, emphasis on stores, commitment to our people, and the incredible connections we make in every community we're in. As a company, we focus on creating positive change to build a healthier, thriving future. In particular, that includes creating an equitable, inclusive and growth-focused environment for our people.

About This Team

Global Supply Chain Technology delivers the platforms and capabilities that power lululemon’s supply chain—from raw material innovation and development, costing, sourcing, quality, sustainability and traceability, trade, logistics, and distribution technology. Our team works in close partnership with core business units to ensure that our supply chain remains agile, efficient, and responsive to ever-evolving market demands. By continuously innovating and refining our technological solutions, we enable best-in-class supply chain operations to service our Guests and our stores. This collaborative approach ensures we provide exceptional experiences and support lululemon’s growth in every community we serve.

The role

We are seeking a Technology Director to define and execute the multi year strategy for modernizing and transforming lululemon’s global sourcing technology ecosystem. This leader will shape the strategic roadmap, elevate costing and sourcing platform capabilities, advance AI driven decisioning, and ensure operational excellence across the systems that connect lululemon to its global vendor base.

You will own all aspects of technology for Global Sourcing—architecture, engineering, security, QA automation, operations, and delivery—and oversee a globally distributed team across North America and India. You will be accountable for the platforms that support approximately 300 raw material (RM) and finished goods (FG) vendors globally, and will partner with Enterprise Architecture and Engineering on the technology evolution required to support enterprise initiatives. This role requires a seasoned leader with a proven record of developing a strong leadership bench, managing complex solutions, and thriving in complex, fast paced, and highly collaborative environments.

Product costing and should-cost modelling (materials, labor, overhead, landed cost)
Sourcing execution (quoting and RFQ, vendor award, capacity allocation and booking)
Purchase order management and order lifecycle for raw material and finished goods
Supplier collaboration portals and vendor-facing self-service
Partner connectivity (vendors, mills, agents, service providers)
Integration frameworks (EDI, APIs, event-driven architecture)
Master data and data quality for cost
Sourcing analytics, margin visibility, exception management, and operational dashboards

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Roadmap

Define and deliver a multi year global sourcing technology strategy that enhances scalability, reliability, and speed to market.
Translate business needs into an actionable engineering roadmap incorporating modernization, cloud migration, supplier collaboration, and responsible AI adoption.
Partner with business Directors, Sr. Directors, and VPs across Global Sourcing and Costing to define, deliver, and support the strategic roadmap.
Enroll cross functional technology partners in the strategic vision for Global Sourcing, and lead the creation and expansion of new capabilities that align with our strategic goals.

Platform & Architecture Modernization

Modernize existing costing and sourcing platforms and integrate next generation capabilities (costing engines, sourcing execution suites, or equivalent).
Drive transformation toward API-first, event-driven, and scalable integration architectures across the global vendor base.
Lead design and implementation of secure, resilient, and responsible data management and governance frameworks for material, vendor, and cost master data.
Partner with Enterprise Architecture and Engineering on technology evolution that supports enterprise initiatives.

Engineering Leadership

Lead globally distributed engineering, QA automation, delivery, and support teams; develop managers and future-ready technical leaders.
Serve as the escalation point for Technology Managers to support delivery, making thoughtful decisions on the fly and constantly clearing roadblocks.
Raise engineering standards around quality, observability, security, and system reliability.
Build high performing, diverse teams with a culture of inclusion, transparency, and continuous improvement, and support career progression and stretch opportunities across the Global Sourcing technology area.

Operational Excellence

Oversee delivery, operations, and vendor/partner management across sourcing and costing systems, and own the relationship with key vendor partners.
Manage budgets for strategic initiatives and baseline opex for Global Sourcing technology, ensuring clear ROI and optimization of total cost of ownership.
Drive root cause analysis, systems reliability, service maturity, and measurable operational improvements.

Innovation & AI Enablement

Introduce AI-driven decision support for should-cost modelling, quote analysis, capacity allocation, vendor performance, and exception management.
Champion ethical, transparent, and responsible use of AI in sourcing and vendor-facing operations.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, related field, or commensurate relative experience.
15+ years of experience in technology, including 4+ years in a senior leadership position such as a Technology Manager or Technology Director.
Experience leading large scale initiatives and modernization efforts for supply chain platforms, with highly valued experience in costing and sourcing areas.
Proven success delivering transformations in areas such as product costing, sourcing execution, purchase order management, supplier collaboration, or vendor connectivity.
Strong background in integration architectures (API platforms, EDI, message streaming, event-driven design).
Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
Proficiency in programming languages such as Python or Java and familiarity with data engineering patterns.
Demonstrated ability to manage large budgets and deliver high-impact technology programs.
Exceptional communication, storytelling, and executive influencing skills.
Continuous learning mindset that stays on the leading edge of sourcing and supply chain technology solutions that can bring value to the organization.
Experience with AI/ML use cases in supply chain, sourcing, or costing.
Understanding of apparel or consumer goods product development, raw materials, and global vendor management processes.
Experience working with distributed teams across multiple time zones and a global vendor base.

Success Metrics

Improved cost accuracy, margin visibility, and speed of costing cycles.
Reduced sourcing and purchase order cycle times, with fewer manual touches per order.
Improved reliability, uptime, and SLA performance of sourcing and costing systems.
Strong engagement scores and leadership development of global teams.

Must Haves

Acknowledges the presence of choice in every moment and takes personal responsibility for their life.
Possesses an entrepreneurial spirit and continuously innovates to achieve great results.
Communicates with honesty and kindness and creates the space for others to do the same.
Leads with courage, knowing the possibility of greatness is bigger than the fear of failure.
Fosters connection by putting people first and building trusting relationships.
Integrates fun and joy as a way of being and working, aka doesn’t take themselves too seriously.

additional notes

Husky TechnologiesTM a company with a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships, a strong sense of community and a unique culture and values. We are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy.

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.

Husky TechnologiesTM Canadian manufacturing facilities and global headquarters are located in Bolton, Ontario on a large, beautiful campus located just 20 minutes north of Toronto’s Pearson International Airport. Features include a fitness and wellness center, intramural sports activities, on-site cafeteria, and clean, state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities with outstanding safety records. We offer a great work environment and competitive total compensation package, including above market retirement savings plan and market competitive group benefits.

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

The Director / GM, Global Marketing & Sales Enablement
is responsible for defining and driving Husky's global brand strategy, leading B2B marketing and demand generation, advancing sustainability advocacy and industry engagement, delivering actionable market intelligence, and improving global sales effectiveness.

Reporting to the EVP, Sales & Marketing, this leader will strengthen Husky's market position and industry influence, build an integrated commercial support function, and connect market insights, customer engagement, and sales capabilities to deliver measurable business growth.

Key Responsibilities

Global Brand Strategy, Marketing & Industry Advocacy
Own Husky's global brand strategy, positioning, identity, and differentiation, ensuring a compelling and consistent presence across markets and customer touchpoints.
Develop and execute global B2B marketing programs that generate qualified leads and commercial opportunities through digital channels, integrated campaigns, account-based marketing, trade shows, and customer events.
Lead Husky's sustainability advocacy and industry engagement strategy, partnering with industry associations, customers, and value-chain stakeholders to advance science-based understanding of plastics, address misconceptions, and promote responsible use, recycling, and circularity.
Represent Husky's perspectives in relevant industry initiatives and advocacy programs, strengthening its reputation as a credible technology leader and constructive voice in sustainability discussions.
Establish metrics to evaluate brand strength, marketing contribution to pipeline, and the reach and effectiveness of advocacy initiatives.
Market Intelligence & Strategic Insights
Lead a centralized market intelligence and research capability serving Sales, Product Line Management, Strategy, Investor Relations, and executive leadership.
Deliver actionable insights on market trends, competitive dynamics, customer needs, sustainability-related market developments, and emerging growth opportunities.
Support strategic planning, market prioritization, product portfolio decisions, and commercial growth initiatives.
Establish systematic approaches to market research, competitive intelligence, and voice-of-customer analysis.
Strategic Customer Engagement & Sales Enablement
Lead the development of executive-level content and strategic narratives for Top-to-Top (T2T) customer meetings, supporting senior leadership and strategic account engagement.
Develop high-impact sales enablement content, including value propositions, product and solution presentations, competitive positioning, case studies, and customer value tools.
Partner with Sales, Product Line Management, and Engineering to ensure differentiated, consistent, and customer-focused messaging.
Equip global commercial teams with the content, knowledge, and capabilities required to engage customers effectively and win business.
Sales Effectiveness & Commercial Excellence
Partner with Sales leadership to improve sales productivity, commercial processes, opportunity management, and overall sales effectiveness.
Drive adoption of sales methodologies, CRM capabilities, digital tools, and AI-enabled solutions to strengthen commercial execution.
Develop scalable approaches to sales training, onboarding, best-practice sharing, and continuous improvement of capability.
Establish performance metrics and improvement initiatives focused on sales efficiency, conversion rates, win rates, and commercial productivity.

Leadership & Experience

The successful candidate will be a strategic, commercially oriented leader with proven experience in global brand management, complex industrial B2B marketing, market intelligence, and sales enablement.

Experience engaging industry associations, building external partnerships, and shaping industry narratives around sustainability, circularity, or related topics is highly desirable.

The role requires strong business acumen, the ability to lead global multidisciplinary teams, and the credibility to influence executive stakeholders while translating market insights and brand strategy into measurable commercial outcomes.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Engineering, or a related field; MBA or other advanced business degree considered an asset
10+ years of progressive leadership experience in global B2B marketing, brand strategy, commercial excellence, or sales enablement within a complex industrial, manufacturing, technology, or capital equipment environment
Demonstrated success developing and executing integrated marketing strategies that drive brand growth, lead generation, customer engagement, and measurable commercial results across global markets.
Proven experience leveraging market intelligence, competitive insights, and voice-of-customer research to influence business strategy, portfolio decisions, and growth initiatives.
Strong track record leading cross-functional and global teams, influencing executive stakeholders, and driving adoption of sales methodologies, CRM platforms, digital tools, and AI-enabled solutions to improve sales effectiveness.

Vacancy: Replacement

Pay Range: $150,000.00 - 185,000.00

No agency or telephone inquiries please.
